mostWorthwhile.text: Building and joining the deeper and outer layers was most worthwhile: it showed how living outer cells get supplies despite having no blood vessels in their layer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the gland and nerve endings was straightforward from the named slots, but felt a little repetitive.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer skin layer has no blood vessels and receives supplies from deeper tissue.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and named slots made the pairings clear, though the slot fittings needed little figuring out.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: seeing the layers connect to the body and discovering their different jobs was interesting, even if some fittings were predictable.
